::: {#rem-prediction-error}
#### Prediction errors and residuals

The [prediction](#def-prediction) in @def-prediction-error can be a [fitted value](#def-fitted-value),
for an [observation](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-observation) used to [fit](model-validation.qmd#def-fitting-procedure) the [model](model-validation.qmd#def-fitted-model),
or a prediction for an observation that was not used to fit the model.
[Prediction error](#def-prediction-error) is oriented the same way as
[estimation error](estimation.qmd#def-estimation-error):
estimate minus true value.

$$
\begin{aligned}
\prederr &= \fitted - \outvar
&& \text{(prediction error)}\\
\erf{\hparam} &= \hparam - \param
&& \text{(estimation error)}
\end{aligned}
$$

For a fitted value,
the prediction error is the negative of the [residual](#def-residual)
(@thm-prediction-error-residual),
so the two differ only in orientation.
:::
